## MKCinema 1.3: the Windows app opens reliably, torrents on desktop, Android and TV

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` (app 1.2.1) | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, Microsoft Edge WebView2 |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` (app 1.3.0) | Android TV 7 or later |
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (the same file) | Android 7 or later |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |
| macOS, Linux | unchanged from 1.0 | |

The Android app installs over 1.2.x and keeps your sign-in. The Windows app has no installer: replace the old `MKCinema.exe`.

### Windows (1.1.0 to 1.2.1)

- **Fixes the app closing right after it opens.** If Microsoft Edge WebView2 failed to start, the app crashed without a message. It now tells you what went wrong, offers Microsoft's WebView2 download when that's the fix, and writes details to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MKCinema\mkcinema.log`.
- One window only, a window sized to your screen that remembers where you left it, true fullscreen for video (and F11), outside links open in your browser, and the page recovers by itself if it crashes.
- **Play torrent sources on this PC** (Settings › Desktop app, off by default). Download only, never uploads or seeds, and the pieces are deleted when it's turned off or the app closes. Settings explains that peers can see your IP before it can be turned on.
- **Discord status** ("Watching" and the title), off by default.

### Android, Android TV and Fire TV (1.2.2 to 1.3.0)

- **Torrents** (Settings › Torrents, off by default), with the same download-only engine. On TV sticks it keeps one torrent at a time and stops if free storage runs low.
- The TV player sends the request headers some sources need, and addon Install links open the app.
- A square Fire TV tile icon.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the web app changes, which every app gets automatically.

The exe isn't code-signed yet, so the first run shows "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

If the Windows app still closes on start, please open an issue and attach `mkcinema.log` from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MKCinema`.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `mkctv.pages.dev`.
